utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and where everything needs to go. Can we sort out the route and drop-off details first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — let’s map out the route and the drop-off spots first, then we can make the timing work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thanks. If you can tell me the stops and the order, I can figure out the timing from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you aiming for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe late Saturday morning would be best for me. That should give folks time after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning works for me too. I’ll help line things up around school drop-off so we can keep it smooth.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly just a quick update on what’s still needed, since I’m hearing things second-hand. If you’ve got the latest list, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the full latest list on me, but I can get it and send it over soon. If you want, I can also check what’s still needed and report back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I drop it off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Anytime after 4 works for me — I’ll be around and can take a look then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll swing by after 4.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — if you can swing by late, that’d still help a lot. I’ll fill you in on the repair drive details when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I can swing by late. Just point me where to go when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help, but can you share the repair drive details first so I can check them carefully?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community shed, and we’re collecting tools, tape, batteries, and any small spare parts. If you want, I can also send the full supply list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — please send the full supply list so I can double-check it before I help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m sorry, I’ve got a lot rattling around in my head. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries at all—just bring yourself, and if you’ve got any spare tools or screws, that’d be great. I’ll send the details over right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll bring myself and see what tools I can dig up. Thanks, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara! We still need a few volunteers for check-in, someone to sort donated supplies, and one person to keep the sign-up sheet updated.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can handle the sign-up sheet and help with check-in if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t logged any details on the repair drive yet, but I can keep track of where things go. Tell me the location you want noted, and I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you note that the repair drive is at my place, by the front gate?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the repair drive is at your place, by the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m happy to keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep asking around too, and we can share any repair drive updates as soon as we hear them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll let you know if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ve been meaning to ask, what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do you want me to confirm the list first, or are you asking what’s still missing from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, confirm the list first, and then tell me what’s still missing from the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Could you start by sorting the donated items by type and setting aside anything broken so we can repair it first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated items by type and set aside anything broken first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep it simple: I can help with the repair drive if we’ve got a clear plan and a set time. Let’s decide what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good—let’s list the repairs first and pick a time that won’t cause a lot of back-and-forth.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good idea. Let’s make a short list now, then choose one afternoon and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I can check in while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you check if they’re still taking donations? I’d like to know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask when I’m out and let you know if they’re still taking donations.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: A few sturdy boxes, packing tape, and a marker would be great — I’m sorting supplies as we go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab those and bring them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m setting up the repair drive details now. If you can help with a time or a list of needed fixes, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. I’m free Saturday morning, and I’ll send a quick list of the fixes I know about.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Saturday morning works well—thank you, Leo. Send the list when you can, and I’ll fold it into the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and check in with folks at the drive? If you’re free, I’d really appreciate an hour or two.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Mara — I can do that. I’ve got an hour or two free and I’m happy to sort donations and check people in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m helping spread the word for the repair drive — want me to put your name down or drop by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please put my name down and drop the details by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put your name down and drop the details by soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive locations now—just tell me where you want me to note next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Opal — I’m still getting the updates second-hand, so where should I send people next?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Send them to the community hall for now, and I’ll keep note of any changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we still need to sort the donated tools and check what’s left on the list. I’ll remind everyone and we can tackle it together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I’ll sort the donated tools when you remind folks, and we can check the list together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Jules. I probably would’ve missed half of it, so keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted and make sure you’re in the loop on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up—looks like folks are really pitching in now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s great to see. I’ve got a few tools ready to lend if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so helpful of you, Gus—people are going to be relieved to have those on hand. I’ll spread the word that you’ve got tools ready to lend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s double-check the repair drive details before we do anything. What time and place are we set for?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time and place did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want to guess—let’s set a clear time and place together. Does Saturday at the community center work for you?
